label: Cold War Files
titel: A War Game Almost Went Wrong

szenen.text: Soviet leaders feared it was cover for a *real attack.*
Soviet air units were *placed on alert.*
A 1990 U.S. report said we *may* have been on a *hair trigger.*
Historians still *debate* how close it came. What's your view?
